dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Puti arrived at MACC following a bite incident in the home. Her previous owner states that she has been showing aggressive behavior in the home since her owner passed away. When the owner's partner was hugging Puti she bit them on the forehead. This bite broke skin and bled. Due to the detailed behavior we revommrnd an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Puti
